s: asvAmivikrayaH

puM, (asvAminA anaDikAriRA kfto vikrayaH .) asvAmikartfkavikrayaH । yaTA sampratyasvAmivikrayAKyaM vyavahArapadamupakramate । tasya ca lakzaRaM nAradenoktaM । “nikziptaM vA paradravyaM nazwaM lavDvApahftya vA । vikrIyate'samakzaM yatsajYeyo'svAmivikrayaH” ॥ iti tatra kimityAha । “svayaM laBetAnyavikrItaM kreturddozo'prakASite । hInAdrahohInamUlye velAhIne ca taskaraH” ॥ svaM AtmasambanDidravyaM anyavikrItamasvAMmivikrItaM yadi paSyati tadA laBeta gfhRIyAt । asvAmivikrayasya svatvahetutvABAvAt । vikrItagrahaRaM dattAhitayorupalakzaRArTaM । asvAmikftatvena tulyatvAt । ataevoktaM । asvAmivikrayaM dattamADiYca vinivarttayediti । kretuH punaraprakASite gopite kraye dozo Bavati । taTA hInAttaddravyAgamopAyahInAt । rahasi cEkAnte samBAvyadravyAdapi hInamUlye alpatareRa mUlyena kraye । velAhIne velayA hIno velAhInaH krayo rAtryAdO kftaH tatra ca kretA taskaro Bavati । taskaravat daRqaBAk BavatotyarTaH । yaToktaM । “dravya masvAmivikrItaM prApya svAmI tadApnuyAt । prakASakrayataH SudDiH kretuH steyaM rahaHkrayAt” iti ॥ svAmyaBiyuktena kretrA kiM karttavyamityata Aha । “nazwApahftamAsAdya harttAraM grAhayennaraM । deSakAlAtipattO ca gfhItvA svayamarpayet” ॥ nazwamapahftaM vAnyadIyaM krayAdinA prApya harttAraM grAhayet cOrodDaraRakAdiBiH । AtmaviSudDyaTa rAjadaRqAprAptyarTaYca । aTAviditadeSAntaraM gataH kAlAntare vA vipannastadA mUlasamAharaRASaktervikretAramadarSayitvEva svayameva tadDanaM nAzwikasya samarpayet । tAvatEvAsO SudDo BavatIti SrIkarAcAryyeRa vyAKyAtaM । tadidamanupapannaM । vikreturddarSanAcCudDirityanena pOnaruktaprasaNgAt । ato 'nyaTA vyAKyAyate । nazwApahftamiti nAzwikaM pratyayamupadeSaH । nazwamapahftaM vA AtmIyaM dravyamAsAdya kretfhastasTaM jYAtvA taM harttAraM kretAraM sTAnapAlAdiBirgrAhayet । deSakAlAtipattO deSakAlAtikrame sTAnapAlAdyasanniDAne tadvijYApanakAlAt prAkpalAyanASaNkAyAM svayameva gfhItvA teByaH samarpayet ॥ * ॥ grAhite harttari kiM karttavyamityata Aha । “vikreturddarSanAcCudDiH svAmI dravyaM nfpo damaM । kretA mUlyamavApnoti tasmAdyastasya vikrayI” । yadyasO gfhItaH kretA na mayeda mapahftaM anyasakASAt prAptamiti vakti tadA tasya kretu rvikretfdarSanamAtreRa SudDirBavati । na punarasAvaBiyojyaH । kintu tatpradarSitena vikretrA saha nAzwikasya vivAdaH । yaTAha vfhaspatiH । “mUle samAhfte kretA nABiyojyaH kaTaYcana । mUlena saha vAdasta nAzwikasya viDIyate” ॥ iti tasmiMSca vivAde yadyasvAmivikrayaniScayo Bavati tadAsya nazwApahftasya gavAdidravyasya yo vikrayI vikretA tasya sakASAt svAmI nAzwikaH svIyaM । dravyamavApnoti cOraScAparADAnurUpaM daRqaM kretA ca mUlyamavApnoti । aTAsO deSAntaraM gataH tadA yojanasaNKyayAnayanATa kAlo deyaH । “prakASaM vA krayaM kuryyAt mUlaM vApi samarpayet । mUlAnayanakAlaSca deya statrADvasaNKyayeti smaraRAt ॥ * ॥ aTAvijYAtadeSatayA mUlamAharttuM na Saknoti tadA krayaM SoDayitvEva SudDo Bavati । asamAhAryyamUlastu krayameva viSoDayediti manuvacanAt । yadA punaH sAkzyAdiBiH rddivyena vA krayaM na SoDayati mUlaYca na pradarSayati tadA sa eva daRqaBAgBavatIti । “anupasTApayanmUlaM krayaM vApyaviSoDayan । yaTABiyogaM Danine DanaM dApyo damaYca saH” ॥ iti smaraRAt । svaM laBetAnyavikrItamityuktaM ॥ * ॥ tallipmunA kiM karttavyamityata Aha । “AgamenopaBogena nazwaM BAvyamato 'nyaTA । paYcabanDo damastasTa rAjYe tenAviBAvite” ॥ Agamena rikTakrayAdinA upaBogena ca madIyamidaM dravyaM taccEvaM nazwamapahftaM vetyapi BAvyaM sADanIyaM tatsvAminA ato'nyaTA tena svAminA aviBAvite paYcabanDo nazwadravyasya paYcamAMSo damo nAzwikena rAjYe deyaH ॥ * ॥ atrEvAyaM kramaH । pUrvvasvAmo nazwamAtmIyaM sADayet tataH kretA cOryyaparihArArTaM mUlyalABAya ca vikretAramAnayet । aTAnetuM na Saknoti tadAtmadozaparihArAya krayaM SoDavitvA nAzwikasya samarpayediti ॥ * ॥ taskarasya pracCAdakaM pratyAha । “hftaM praRazwaM yo dravyaM parahastAdavApnuyAt । anivedya nfpe daRqyaH sa tu zaRRavatiM paRAn” ॥ hftaM praRazwaM vA cOrAdihastasTaM dravyamanena madIyaM dravyamapahftamiti nfpasyAnivedyEva darpAdinA yo gfhRAtyasO zaquttarAn navatipaRAn daRqanIyaH । taskarapracCAdakatvena duzwatvAt ॥ * ॥ rAjapuruzAnItaM pratyAha । “SOlkikEH sTAnapAlErvvA nazwApahftamAhftaM । arvvAk sambatsarAt svAmI hareta parato nfpaH” ॥ yadA tu SulkADikAriBiH sTAnarakziBirvvA nazwamapahftaM dravyaM rAjapArSvaM pratyAnItaM tadA saMvatsarAdarbbAkprAptaScet nAzwikastaddravyamavApnuyAt । UrdDvaM punaH saMvatsarAdrAjA gfhRIyAt । svapuruzAnItaYca dravyaM janasamUhezUdGozya yAvat saMvatsaraM rAjYA rakzaRIyaM । yaTAha gOtamaH । praRazwamasvAmika maDigamya rAjYe prabrUyurviKyApya sambatsaraM rAjYA rakzyamiti । yat punarmanunA viDyantaramuktaM -- “praRazwasvAmikaM dravyaM rAjA tryabdaM niDApayet । arvvAktryabdAt haret svAmI paratonfpatirharet” ॥ iti ॥ tacCatavfttasampannabrAhmaRavizayaM । rakzaRanimittaM zaqBAgAdigrahaRaYca tenEvoktaM । “AdadItATa zaqBAgaM praRazwADigatAnnfpaH । daSamaM dvAdaSaM vApi satAM Darmmamanusmaran” ॥ iti । tftIyadvitIyapraTamavatsarezu vaTAkramaM zazWAdayo BAgA veditavyAH । prapaYcitaYcEtat purastAt ॥ * ॥ manUktazaqBAgAdigrahaRasya dravyaviSeze apavAdamAha । “paRAnekaSaPe dadyAt caturaH paYca mAnuze । mahizozwragavAM dvO dvO pAdaM pAdamajAvike” ॥ ekaSaPe aSvAdO praRazwADigate tatsvAmI rAjYe rakzAnimittaM caturaH paRAn dadyAt । mAnuze manuzyajAtIye dravye paYca paRAn । mahizozwragavAM rakzaRanimittaM pratyekaM dvO dvO paRO । ajAvike punaH pratyekaM pAdaM pAdaM dadyAditi sarvvatrAnuzajyate । ajAvikamiti samAsanirddeSe'pi pAdaM pAdamiti vIpsAbalAt pratyekaM sambanDo gamyate ॥ ityasvAmikavikrayaprakaraRaM । iti mitAkzarAyAM zyavahArADyAyaH ॥
v: asvAmivikraya

pu॰ asvAminA kfto vikrayaH । 1 asvAminA kfte vikraye 2 tadvizaye vyavahAraBede ca । yaTAha nAradaH “nikziptaM vA paradravyaM nazwaM labDvA'pahftya vA । vikrIyate'samakzaM yat sajYeyo'svAmivikraya” iti । tatra kimityAha yA॰ “svaM laBetAnyavikrItaM kreturdozo'prakASite । hInAdraho hInamUlye velAhIne ca taskaraH” “svamAtma sambanDi dravyaM anyavikrItamasvAmivikrItaM yadi paSyati tadA laBeta gfhaRIyAt । asvAmivikrayasya svatvahetutvA BAvAt । vikrItagrahaRandattAhitayorupalakzaRArTam asvAmikftatvena tulyatvAt । ataevoktam । “asvAmivikrayandattamADiYca vinivartayediti” kretuH punaraprakASite gopite kraye dozo Bavati । taTA hInAttaddravyAgamopAyahInAt । rahasi cEkAnte samBAvyadravyAdapi hInamUlyenAlpatareRa mUlyena ca krave velAhIne velayA hInovelAhInaH krayorAtryAdO tatra kftaH kretA taskaro Bavati taskaravat daRqaBAgBavatItyarTaH । yaToktam । “dravyamasvAmivikrItamprApya svAmI tadApnuyAt । prakASakrayataH SudDiH kretuH steyaM rahaHkrayAditi” svAmyaBiyuktena kretrA kiM kartavyamityata Aha । “nazwApahftamAsAdya hartAraM grAhayennaram । deSakAlAtipattO ca gfhItvA svayamarpaMyet” yA॰ nazwamapahftaM vAnyadIyaM krayAdinA prApya hartAraM vikretAraM grAhayeccOrodDaraRakAdiBiH AtmaviSuDyarTaM rAjadaRqA prAptyarTaYca । “aTAviditadeSAntaraNgataH kAlAntare vA vipannaM stadA mUlasamAharaRASaktervikretAramadarSayitvEva svayameva tadDanannAzwikasya samarpayet tAvatEvAsO SudDo BavatIti” SrIkarAcAryyeRa vyAKyAtam । tadidamanupapannam । vikreturddarSanAcCudDirityanena pOnaruktyaprasaNgAt । ato'nyaTA vyAKyAyate । nazwApahftamiti nAzwikamprati ayamupadeSaH । nazwamapahftaM AtmIyandravyamAsAdya kretfhastasTaM jYAtvA taM harttAraM kretAraM sTAnapAlAdiBirgrAhayet deSakAlAtipattO deSakAlAtikrame sTAnapAlAdyasanniDAne tadvijYApanakAlAtprAkMpalAyanASaNkAyAM svayameva gfhItvA teByaH samarpayet । grAhite harttari kiM karttavyamityata Aha । “vikreturdarSanAcCudDiH svAmI dravyaM nfpodamam । kretA mUlyamavApnoti tasmAdyastasya vikrayI” yA॰ yadyasO gfhItaH kretA na mayedamapahftam anyasakASAt prAptamiti vakti tadA tasya kreturvikreta darSanamAtreRa SudDirBavati । na punarasAvaBiyojyaH । kintu tatpradarSitena vikretrA saha nAzwikasya vivAdaH । yaTAha vfhaspatiH । “mUle samAhfte kretA nABiyojyaH kaTaYcana । mUlena saha vAdastu nAzwikasya viDIyata” iti । tasmiMSca vivAde yadyasvAsivikrayaniScayo Bavati tadA tasya nazwApahftasya gavAdidravyasya yo vikrayI vikretA tasya sakASAtsvAmI nAzwikaH svIyaM dravyamavApnoti nfpaScAparADAnurUpandaRqaM kretA ca mUlyamavApnoti । aTAsO deSAntaraNgatastadA yojanasaMKyayA''na yanArTaM kAlodeyaH । “prakASaM vA krayaM kuryyAnmUlaM vApi samarpayet । mUlAnayanakAlaSca deyastatrADvasaMKyayeti” smaraRAt । aTAvijYAtadeSatayA mUlamAhartunna Saknoti tadA krayaM SoDayitvEva SudDo Bavati । “asamAhAryamUlastu krayameva viSoDayediti” manuvacanAt । yadA punaH sAkzyA diBirdivyena vA krayaM na SoDayati mUlaYca na pradarSayati tadA sa eva daRqaBAgBavatIti । “anupasTApayanmUlaM krayaMvApyaviSoDayan । yaTABiyoganDanine DanandApyodamaYca sa” iti smaraRAt । svaM laBetAnyavikrItamityuktam tallipsunA kiM karttavyamityata Aha । “AgamenopaBogena nazwamBAvyamato'nyaTA । paYcabanDodamastasya rAjYe tenA viBAvite” Agamena rikTakrayAdinA upaBogena ca madIyamidandravyaM taccEvaM nazwamapahftaM vetyapi BAvyaM sADanIyantatskAminA । ato'nyaTA tena KAminA aviBAvite paYcabanDo nazwadravyasya paYcamAMSodamonAzwikena rAjYe deyaH । atrEvAyaM kramaH । pUrvvaM svAmI nazwamAtmIyaM sADayettataH kretAcOryya parihArArTaM mUlyalABAya ca vikretAramAnayet । aTAnetunna Saknoti tadAtmadozaparihArAya krayaM SoDayitvA dravyaM nAzwikasya samarpayediti । taskarasya pracCAdakampratyAha । “hftaM pranazwaM yodravyamparahastAdavApnuyAt । anivedya nfpe daRqyaH sa tu zaRRavatimpaRAn” yA॰ । hftampra nazwaM vA cOrAdihastasTaM dravyam anenamadIyandravyamapahftamiti nfpasyAnivedyEva darpAdinA yogfhRAtyasO zaquttarAnnavavatimpaRAndaRqanIyastaskarapracCAdakatvena duzwatvAt । rAjapuruzAnItaM pratyAha । “SOlkikEH sTAnapAlErvvA nazwApahftamAhftam । arvAk saMvatsarAtsvAmI hareta paratonfpaH” yA॰ । yadA tu SulkADikAriBiH sTAnarakziBirvA nazwamapahftandravyaM rAjapArSvaM pratyAnItantadAsaMvatsarAdarvAk prAptaScennAzwikastaddravyamavApnuyAt । UrdDvaM punaH saMvatsarAdrAjA gfhRIyAt । svapuruzAnItaYca dravyaM janasamUhezUdGozya yAvadvatsaraM rAjYA rakzaRIyam । yaTAha gotamaH । “pranazwamasvAmikamaDigamya rAjYe prabruyurviKyApya saMvatsaraM rAjYA rakzyamiti” yatpunarmmanunAvaDyantaramuktam । pranazwasvAmikaM dravyaM rAjA tryabdaM niDApayet । arvvAka tryabdAdDa cetsvAmI paratonfpatirharet” iti । tacCrutavfttasampannabrAhmaRavizayam । rakzaRanimittaM zaqBAgAdigrahaRaYca tenEvoktam । “AdadItATa zaqBAga mpranazwAGigatAnnfpaH । daSamaM dvAdaSaM vApi satAnDarmma manusmaranniti” । tftIyadvitIyapraTamavatsarezu yaTAkramaM zazWAdayo BAgAveditavyAH । prapaYcitaYca tatpurastAt । sanUktazaqBAgAdigrahaRasya dravyaviSeze apavAdamAha । “paRAnekaSaPe dadyAccaturaHpaYca mAnuze । mahizozwragavAM dvO dvO, pAdampAdamajAvike” yA॰ । ekaSaPe aSvAdO prAzwADigate tatsvAmI rAjYe rakzaRanimittaYcaturaHpaRAn dadyAt । mAnuze manuzyajAtIye dravye paYca paRAn mahizozwragavAM rakzaRanimittampratyekaM dvO dvOpaRO, ajAvike punaH pratyekampAdamprAdaM dadyAditi sarvatrAnuzajyate । ajAvikamiti samAsanirdeSe'pi pAdampAdamiti vIpsAvalAtpratyekaM sambanDogamyate” mitA॰ ॥ prAyaScitta tattve tu cOrAllABavizaye viSezodarSito yaTA “prakASakraye tu svAminograhaRenAradavfhaspatI । vaRigvITIparigataM vijYAtaM rAjapuruzEH । avijYAtASrayAt krItaM vikretA yadi vA mftaH । svAmI dattvArdDamUlyantu pragfhRIta svakanDanam । ardDaM dvayorapahftaM tatra syAt vyavahArataH । avijYAtakraye dozastaTA cAparipAlane । etatdvayaM samAKyAtaM dravyahAnikaraM param” iti ।
m: अ-स्वामि-विक्रय m. sale of property by one who is not the rightful owner, Mn. viii, 4 (cf. IW. 261).

s: asvAmyaM
klI, (na svAmyam । naYsamAsaH । svAmitvABAvaH । yaTA devalaH । “asvAmyaM hi BavedezAM nirddoze pitari sTite” । iti dAyatattvaM ॥
v: asvAmya
na॰ aBAve na॰ ta॰ । 1 svAmyABAve svatvABAye na॰ ba॰ । 2 svatvaSUnye tri॰ । asyAmyaM hi Bavettatra” smftiH
a: अस्वाम्य — a. 1 Unowned. --2 Not one's own. --म्यं Absence of right to property.

m: अ-स्वार्थ mfn. not fit for a proper object, useless, BhP.
unselfish, disinterested, L.
useless, BhP.
अ-स्वार्थ अ-स्वास्थ्य. See अ-स्व.

s: asvAsTyaM

klI, susTatvABAvaH । susTatArAhityaM । svAsTyasyABAvaH asvAsTyamityavyayIBAvasamAsanizpannaM ॥ (yaTA SiSupAlabaDe । “vigfhya cakre namucidvizA balI ya itTamasvAsTyamaharddivandivaH” ॥ Bukte svAsTyamupEti ca, iti grahaRIroge'BihitaM mADavakareRa saMgfhItaYca । atra hi aBukte'svAsTyamiti tAtparyyaM ॥)
v: asvAsTya
na॰ aBAve na॰ ta॰ । 1 svAsTyABAve “ya itTamasvAsTyamahardivaM divaH” mAGaH । 2 rogAdidyaBiBave ca na॰ ba॰ । 3 tadvati tri॰ ।
m: अ-स्वास्थ्य n. indisposition, sickness, discomfort, BhP.; Kathās.
a: अस्वास्थ्यं — 1 Indisposition, sickness. --2 Absence of ease or comfort, trouble, anxiety; य इत्थमस्वास्थ्यमहर्दिवं दिवः Śi. 1. 51.

v: asvAtantrya
na॰ aBAve na॰ ta॰ । svAtantryABAve parADInatve na॰ ta॰ । 2 tadvati tri॰ ।
m: अ-स्वातन्त्र्य n. dependence, MaitrUp.

v: asvAveSa
tri॰ svasmin svasTAne syaBAve vA AviSati A + viSa--ac 7 ta॰ । svasTAne svaBAve vA asTite “jaradazwyasvAveSam” f॰ 7, 38, 7 ।
asvErin
pu॰ svErI svADInaH na॰ ta॰ । 1 paratantre । striyAM NIp
asvIkAra
pu॰ aBAve na॰ ta॰ । 1 svIkArABAve na॰ ba॰ । 2 tacCUnye tri॰ । svIkAro'NgIkAraH pratigrahaSca ।
m: अ-स्वीकार m. non-acquiescence, dissent, L.

v: asvIkfta
tri॰ na svIkftaH 1 gfhItaBinne 2 aNgokftaBinne ca ।
m: अ-स्वीकृत mfn. refused, L.

s: asvaH

tri, (asa + van) kzudravastumAtram । tatparyyAyaH । vAmanaH 2 nyaN 3 nIcaH 4 KarvvaH 5 । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 70 । nIcEH 6 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ anuccaH 7 । iti jawADara ॥ tadvEdikaparyyAyaH । fhan 1 hrasvaH 2 niGfzvaH 3 mAzukaH 4 pratizWA 5 kfDu 6 vamrakaH 7 daBram 8 arBakaH 9 kzullakaH 10 alpaH 11 । ityekAdaSa hrasvanAmAni । iti vedanirGaRwO 3 aDyAyaH ॥
v: asva
tri॰ nAsti svanDanamasya । 1 nirdDane । svaH svakIyaH na॰ ta॰ । 2 svakIyaBinne tri॰ । etadarTe'sya sarvvanAmatayA akac । asvakaH striyAM tu nityamata ittvam asvikA ।
m: अ-स्व mfn. having no property, MBh.
a: अस्व — a. 1 Indigent, poor (नास्ति स्वं धनं यस्य). --2 Not one's own.

m: अ-स्व—भाव m. unnatural or unusual character or temperament
अ-स्व—भाव mfn. of a different nature, L.
a: अस्वभाव — a. Of a different nature. --वः Different or unnatural character.

m: अ-स्व—धर्म m. neglect of one's duty, Diś.

a: अस्वंत — a. Ending, ill. --तः Death. --तं fireplace (अश्मंत q. v.).
अस्वच्छंद — a. 1 Not self-willed, dependent. --2 Docile, tractable.

s: asvacCandaH
tri, (na svacCandaH । naYsamAsaH .) aDInaH । AyattaH । ityamaraH ॥
v: asvacCanda
tri॰ viroDe na॰ ta॰ । svacCandaBinne parADIne ।
m: अ-स्व—च्छन्द mfn. not self-willed, dependant, L.
docile, L.

k.v: परतन्त्रः पराधीनः परवान्नाथवानपि। अधीनो निघ्न आयत्तोऽस्वच्छन्दो गृह्यकोऽप्यसौ॥

m: अ-स्व—दृश् mfn. not seeing one's self or soul, BhP.
अ-स्वदित mfn. not made agreeable to the taste or sweet, ŚBr. i.
अ-स्व—ग (अ-स्व-), mfn. not going to one's own home, homeless, AV. xii, 5, 45
अ-स्व—ग—ता f. homelessness, AV. ix, 2, 3; xii, 5, 40.
accord. to some = अ-स्वस्थता, ‘ill health’, others, ‘dependence’, AV. ix, 2, 3.

v: asvajAti
tri॰ na svasyeva jAtiryasya । BinnajAtO yaTA viprasya kzatriyAdi
m: अ-स्व—जाति mfn. of a different caste, Mn. ix, 86.
अ-स्वक mf(अका or इका, Pāṇ. vii, 3, 47)n. = अस्व, q.v., L.
a: अस्वक, --अस्वकीय, अस्विक — a. Not one's own, belonging to another. --Comp. --ग a. Ved. not going to one's home, homeless; ˚ता Ved. homelessness. --जातिः a. of a different caste or kind.

m: अ-स्वन mfn. not having a clear sound, VarBṛS.

v: asvanta
na॰ asUnAm anto yasmAt 5 ba॰ । 1 cUllyAM tasyAH prARibaDahetutayA mUnAsTAnarUpatvAt taTAtvam । suzWu na anto yasya । 2 aSuBodarke tri॰ । 6 ta॰ । 3 maraRe pu॰ ।
m: अस्व्-अन्त See अश्वन्त.
अ-स्वन्त mfn. (स्व्-अन्त), ending ill, having an unfavourable issue
(see also अस्व्-अन्त s.v. अश्वन्त.)
अ-स्वपत् mfn. not sleeping, Suparṇ.

s: asvapnaH

puM, (nAsti svapno nidrA yasya .) devatA । ityamaraH ॥ (nidrAyA aBAvArTe yaTA, -- “asvapnaH santatAruk ca majjAsTikupite'nile” ॥ iti mADavakaraH ॥) “majjasTo'sTizu sOziryyamasvapnaM stabDatAM rujaM” ॥ iti vABawaH ॥)
v: asvapna

pu॰ nAsti svapnonidrA yasya । 1 deve । 2 nidrArahite tri॰ । devAnAM svapnAvasTArAhityamuktam Sata॰ brA॰ । yaTA “na vE devAH svapantyanavarudDo vA etasyAsvapno Bavati” divAsvapnABAve'pi rAtrO svapnavato'svapnatvamuktam BA॰ SA॰ pa॰ 2213 a॰ । “dAnanityaH pavitraSca asvapnaSca divA'svapan” ।
m: अ-स्वप्न m. sleeplessness, ŚBr. iii; ṢaḍvBr. (अम्, n.), VarBṛS.
अ-स्वप्न mfn. (= ἄϋπνος) not sleeping, watchful, AV.
not dreaming, NṛsUp.
अ-स्वप्न m. ‘sleepless’, a god, L.
a: अस्वप्न — a. Sleepless, wakeful. --प्नः 1 A god, deity. --2 Sleeplessness.

k.v: आदितेया दिविषदो लेखा अदितिनन्दनाः। आदित्या ऋभवोऽस्वप्ना अमर्त्या अमृतान्धसः॥

m: अ-स्वप्नज् mfn. not sleepy, sleepless, RV. ii, 27, 9; iv, 4, 12; VS.
अ-स्वरादि mfn. not beginning with a vowel.

v: asvarUpa
tri॰ na svasyeva rUpamasya । samAnasvaBAvaSUnye “na tvasyarUpa” iti mugDabo॰ ।
m: अ-स्व—रूप mfn. essentially different, L.
shapeless (opposed to रूप-वत्), BhP.

s: asvaraH
tri, (apraSastaH svaro yasya .) mandasvarayuktaH । tatparyyAyaH । asOmyasvaraH 2 । ityamaraH ॥ (“aTa gadgadaSabdastu vilapan vasuDADipaH । uvAca mfdumandArTaM vacanaM dInamasvaram” ॥ iti rAmAyaRe ॥)
v: asvara
pu॰ apraSastaH svaroyatra । 1 mandasvarayukte “vacanaM dInamasvaram” rAmA॰ । 2 svaravarRarahite vyaYjanavarRamAtre pu॰ । 3 udAttAdisvararahite lOkikoccAraRe ca ।
m: अ-स्वर mfn. not loud (as the voice), indistinct, R. ii, 42, 26
having no vowel, Up.; having no accent, APrāt., Sch.
having a bad or croaking voice, L.
a: अस्वर — a. 1 Having a bad voice. --2 Indistinct, not loud, in a low tone (as a speech). --रः 1 A low tone. --2 A consonant. --3 Absence of any accent. --रं ind. Not aloud, in a low tone.

k.v: लोहलः स्यादस्फुटवाग्गर्ह्यवादी तु कद्वदः। समौ कुवादकुचरौ स्यादसौम्यस्वरोऽस्वरः॥

m: अ-स्वरक mfn. unaccentuated, Pat.
अ-स्वरम् (अम्), ind. in low tone, indistinctly, ŚBr. xi.

v: asvargya
tri॰ svargAya hitaM svarga + yat na॰ ta॰ । svargAsADane “asvargyaM lokavidvizwaM tasmAttat parivarjjayet” manuH “asvargyaM lokavidvizwaM DarmmyamapyAcarenna tu” smftiH ।
m: अ-स्वर्ग्य mfn. not leading to heaven, ŚBr. x; Mn.; Bhag. &c.
a: अस्वर्ग्य — a. Not securing or leading to heaven; अस्वर्ग्यं लोकविद्विष्टं धर्ममप्याचरेन्न तु Y. 1. 156.

m: अ-स्वरित mfn. not having the accent called Svarita, Pāṇ., Sch.
अ-स्वर्य mfn. not good for the voice, Suśr.
अ-स्वर्-योग्य mfn. unworthy of heaven, VP.
अ-स्वस्थान mfn. occurring out of its proper place, Drāhy.

v: asvasTa
tri॰ na svasmin svaBAve tizWati sTA--ka 7 ta॰ na॰ ta॰ । svasTaBinne 1 aprakftisTe 2 rogAdinA upadrute ca ।
m: अ-स्व—स्थ mf(आ)n. not in good health, sick, feeling uneasy, Mn. vii, 226; MBh. &c.
not being firm in itself, MBh. xii, 276 (Hit.)
अ-स्वस्थ See अ-स्व.
a: अस्वस्थ — a. Not well, unwell, indisposed, sick; बलवत् अस्वस्था Ś. 3 seriously indisposed; ˚शरीरा ibid., K. 159, 211; ˚ता want of firmness, weakness, ill-ness.

m: अ-स्व—स्थ—शरीर mfn. ill, Kād.
अ-स्व—स्थ—ता f. illness, Ratnāv. (Prākṛt assatthadā)
अ-स्व—ता f. the having no property, L.
unselfishness, Bcar. vi, 10.

a: अस्वतंत्र — a. 1 Dependent, subject, not one's own master; अस्वतंत्रा स्त्री पुरुषप्रधाना Vasiṣṭha. --2 Docile, humble, tractable.

s: asvatantraH
tri, (na svatantraH । naYsamAsaH .) paratantraH । parADInaH । iti jawADaraH ॥
v: asvatantra

tri॰ viroDe na॰ ta॰ । svADInaBinne parADIne । “asvatantrA strI puruzapraDAnA iti” vasi॰ । tasyA asvAtantryaYca tatrEva darSitam “pitA rakzati kOmAre BarttA rakzati yOvane । putraSca sTAvire BAve na strI svAtantryamarhati” taTA putrAdInAmapi janmADInaM svatvamiti sTAvara DanAderyaTezwaviniyoge pitrAderasvAtantryamiti mitAkzarAyAm vyavasTApitaM yaTA “tasmAtpEtfke pEtAmahe ca dravye janmanEva svatvam । taTApi piturAvaSyakezu Darmakftyezu vAcanikezu prasAdadAnakuwumbaBaraRApadvimokzAdizu ca sTAvaravyatirikta dravyaviniyoge svAtantryamiti sTitam । sTAvare tu svArjite pitrAdiprApte ca putrAdipAratantryameva । “sTAvaraM dvipadaYcEva yadyapi svayamarjjitam । asaMBUya sutAnsarvAn na dAnanna ca vikrayaH” । “ye jAtAye'pyajAtASca ye ca garBevyavasTitAH । vfttiYca te'BikANkzanti na dAnanna ca vikrayaH” ityAdi smaraRAt । asyApavAdaH “eko'pi sTAvare kuryyAddAnADamanavikrayam । ApatkAle kuwumbArTe DarmmArTe ca viSezataH” iti । asyArTaH । aprAptavyavahArezu dAnAnujYAnAdAvasamarTezu vA taTAviDezvaviBaktezvapi sarvvakuwumbavyApinyAmApadi tatpozaRe cAvaSyakarttavye sTAvarasya dAnADamanavikrayamekopi samarTaH kuryyAditi” । yattu vacanam । “aviBaktA viBaktAvA sapiRqAH sTAvare samAH । ekohyanISaH sarvvatra dAnADamanavikraye” iti । tadapyaviBaktezu dravyasya maDyasTatvAdekasyAnISvaratvAtsarvvAByanujYA avaSyaM kAryyA viBaktezu tu taduttarakAlaM viBaktAviBaktasaMSayavyudAsAya vyavahArasOkaryyAya ca sarvAByanujYAnaM na punarekasyAnISvaratvena ato viBaktAnAmanumativyatirekeRApi vyavahAraH siDyatyeveti vyAKyeyam” mitA॰ vya॰ a॰ ।
m: अ-स्व—तन्त्र mf(आ)n. not self-willed, dependant, subject, Mn. ix, 2; Gaut.; BhP.
अ-स्व—तन्त्र—ता f. the not being master of one's feelings or passions, Kād.
अ-स्व—त्व n. id., Kathās.
अ-स्व—वेश (अ-स्व-) mfn. having no home of one's own, RV. vii, 37, 7.
अ-स्वेद mfn. not perspiring, L.
अ-स्वेद m. suppressed perspiration, L.
अ-स्वेदन mfn. not perspiring (as feet), VarBṛS.
अ-स्वेद्य mfn. where the application of sudorifics is prohibited, Car.
अ-स्विन्न mfn. not thoroughly boiled, MārkP.
अ-स्विन्न n. non-application of sudorifics, Suśr.
